label: thm:soi:diagonal; prop:soi:incomparable
problem: The last sentence of thm:soi:diagonal says that W^{all,tau} loses at least n-1.37 and W^{cons,tau} at least n-1.37-c_bot 'on such sequences', which naturally reads as every diagonal sequence (one for each computable predictor P). Read that way it is false: for P constantly (1/2,1/2) the tie rule gives e(n)=0 for all n, and the clocked string 'label everything 0' has bounded loss under both W^{all,tau} and W^{cons,tau}. The proof (and sfi Thm 7.4) gives the bound only for the sequence built against P*(D)=(W^{all,tau}(D)+2^{-|D|})/2. prop:soi:incomparable repeats the reading ('on the sequences of thm:soi:diagonal').
fix: In thm:soi:diagonal write: 'Moreover, on the sequence built in this way against the computable predictor P*(D):=(W^{all,tau}(D)+2^{-|D|})/2, W^{all,tau} loses at least n-1.37 and W^{cons,tau} at least n-1.37-c_bot, while W_A, W_A^{chk,t}, W_A^{gen,t} lose at most log(1/omega_0).' In prop:soi:incomparable write 'on a computable sequence (thm:soi:diagonal applied to P*)'.

label: paragraph before prop:basic:wholetheory
problem: 'The bound K_eq(T) <= K_A(D)+c of thm:basic:loss' cites an inequality that thm:basic:loss does not contain; it proves L_A <= K_eq(T)+c and L_A <= K_A(D_n)+c.
fix: 'The bounds of thm:basic:loss are stated with K_eq(T), the length of a single shortest index of a theory equivalent to T; for whole theories the question is how K_eq compares with the mixture weight m_eq.'

label: prop:basic:crorder (proof)
problem: The proof opens with 'Write zeta_{i,j} for the sentence e_{i,j} of the statement', but the statement in basic.tex already defines zeta_{i,j}; no e_{i,j} appears in the paper (a leftover from fundamentals Prop 7.2(b)).

label: before prop:basic:invariance
problem: 'Neither the universal machine nor the background matters beyond a constant factor' overstates prop:basic:background, which is one-sided and says that the converse fails (M_A^{B'}(D)=0 < M_A^B(D) is possible).
fix: 'The universal machine matters only up to a constant factor, and building knowledge into the background gains at most a constant number of bits:'

label: rem:setting:defects
problem: '(Bel_D, Pl_D) is a coherent lower and upper probability (prop:basic:geometric)': the cited part (c) proves only that one probability lies between them (avoiding sure loss), not that Bel_D is their lower envelope. The stronger claim is true (enumerate the negated sentence first in the completion construction), but neither the paper nor fundamentals Prop 2.2 proves it.
fix: Write 'there is a probability on the complete extensions lying between Bel_D and Pl_D (prop:basic:geometric(c))', or add to the proof of (c): 'Enumerating the negation of chi first gives a P_D with P_D(chi)=Bel_D(chi), so Bel_D is the lower envelope of these probabilities.'

label: sec:soi:presburger (sentence before prop:soi:presburgerCharged)
problem: 'With deduction charged, SAI meets the same bound:' names no reading. The doubly exponential bound is proved only for size and material; under (a1) only exponential instance sizes (doubly exponential is open); (a2) and (b2) are open. This echoes the clause withdrawn in the source (sfi Prop 9.4, §16 M1) and breaks CLAIMS global rule 4.
fix: 'With derivation size or material charged, SAI needs doubly exponential budgets as well, and under (a1) at least exponential instance sizes:'

label: tab:soi, paragraph 'How to read the table'
problem: 'they separate only through logical closure, observed independence, consistency constraints of unbounded arity, or deduction that is free' claims an exhaustive list, which is not proved; the record says only that the content of SAI beyond SOI lies in logically structured data (sfi §5.5).
fix: 'the separations we know come from logical closure, observed independence, consistency constraints of unbounded arity, or deduction that is free.'

label: tab:soi (row: axiom-side penalties)
problem: The row lists W_A^{Kt,t} with versions that are asymptotically equal to the unpenalised ones under the relation '≍ unpenalised', but W_A^{Kt,t} is only within 2^c and 2^c t(m_0) of W^1 (weights 2^{-|f|}/(|f|+1)), not of W^cons (prop:soi:kt; sfi §11 row 19 is a separate row).
fix: Split the row: 'M_A^{chk,t}, M_A^{gen,t}; W_A^{chk,t}, W_A^{gen,t} -- ≍ unpenalised, also class by class' and 'W_A^{Kt,t} -- within 2^{±c} and t(m_0) of W^1: a labeller pays log(|f|+1)+O(1) bits ((S))'.

label: rem:soi:lengths (ii)
problem: For clocks in bit length the substitution gives tau <= 2^{2^{c' kappa_0 m}}, so the condition needs c' kappa_0 < c, not the c' < c of the propositions (the same looseness is in sfi Rem 9.0(ii)).
fix: Add 'with c' < c/kappa_0 (and likewise for the singly exponential clocks)'.

label: paragraph after prop:basic:demski
problem: 'the processes are computable relative to emptyset', since consistency of a finite set is Pi^0_1' is right for Process 1, but Process 2 keeps possibly infinite theories r.e. in the tapes; its consistency test is Pi^0_1 relative to the tapes and needs their jump. The parenthesis justifies only non-computability.
fix: 'Process 1 is computable relative to emptyset', since consistency of a finite set is Pi^0_1; Process 2 needs a consistency test relative to the tapes; neither is computable, since a single draw of Process 2 can output one sentence.'

label: def:setting:fresh
problem: 'a constant e, unary function symbols s_0, s_1 and R' reads R as a third unary function symbol; it is the unary relation symbol (terms Def 1.2: L_O = {e, s_0, s_1, R}).
fix: 'a constant e, unary function symbols s_0, s_1, and the unary relation symbol R'.

label: rem:setting:versions (b); def:setting:versions
problem: 'and likewise for the Kolmogorov versions' refers to a Kolmogorov version of polynomial-delay enumerators that def:setting:versions never defines (also in fundamentals Prop 1.8(b)).
fix: Define K_A^{gen,t} in def:setting:versions ('the least length of such an enumerator compatible with D'), or state (b) as |K_A(D) - min{|p| : p a compatible enumerator of the delay form}| <= c.

label: thm:basic:nocoding; prop:soi:independent; prop:soi:noRE; cor:soi:transfer; tab:soi
problem: Omega_V^{>=l} (\Omtail) and Kpad appear in theorem statements of §3–§4 but are defined nowhere in the main text; app-notation points to sec:setting:data, thm:basic:nocoding and sec:soi:literals, where they are not defined.
fix: Add to 'Algorithmic notation' in setting.tex: 'Omega_V^{>=l} := sum{2^{-|p|} : p in dom V, |p| >= l}, the tail of Omega_V, and Kpad(n) := min_{n'>=n} K(n'), nondecreasing and unbounded.'
